# SOW Quality

> Quality gate for Aleysian client-facing Statements of Work and other contract-class deliverables (MSAs, Change Orders, proposals with contractual scope).

**What it does.** Use to review, audit, de-slop, tighten, or finalize a SOW or contract, as the final authoring pass after a SOW is generated and before scope review, or to apply the Basis of Estimate framework to a new tier. It audits structure and language: structural de-slop, Basis of Estimate (volumetric assumptions into Exhibit A with soft and hard Change Order triggers), and cross-reference discipline.

**Related.** Depends on [`knowledge-hub`](../knowledge-hub/README.md); Used by [`quality-gate`](../quality-gate/README.md).
